definitions.explanation: Living, green grass or plants, as opposed to dried or withered vegetation. Evokes the fresh, vibrant greenery of spring and summer.

examples.japanese: {青草|あおくさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青草|あおくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: The cows are eating fresh grass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青草|あおくさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{覆|おお}われて→覆う：02020_oou⟧、{気持|きも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In spring the fields are covered with green grass — it's a pleasant season.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (green/blue) and ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass/plants). In Japanese, ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ is traditionally used for the color of vegetation, not ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧. This is the same usage seen in ⟦{青葉|あおば}→青葉：20092_aoba⟧ (green leaves) and {青田|あおた} (green rice paddies).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青草|あおくさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ — the smell of fresh grass
- {青草|あおくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧ — to mow green grass
- {青草|あおくさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧ — green grass grows

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧ — weeds (unwanted plants, regardless of color)
- ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧ — lawn; turf (cultivated grass)
- {枯|か}れ{草|くさ} — dried/dead grass (the opposite of {青草|あおくさ})
- ⟦{牧草|ぼくそう}→牧草：25486_bokusou⟧ — pasture grass; fodder (grass specifically for livestock)
